title: Information Security & Cybersecurity Policy
description: How MoneyCash protects the confidentiality, integrity, availability, and privacy of customer and business information assets.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: The purpose of this Information Security & Cybersecurity Policy ("Policy") is to establish a framework for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, availability, privacy, and security of information assets managed by MoneyCash.

As a digital lending platform handling customer information, KYC documents, financial data, and lending-related transactions, MoneyCash is committed to implementing appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect information assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction, misuse, or cyber threats.

sections.title: Objectives
paragraphs: - Protect customer information and confidential business data.
- Prevent unauthorized access and data breaches.
- Ensure business continuity and operational resilience.
- Promote a culture of security awareness.

sections.title: Information Security Principles
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall manage information security based on the following principles:
- Information shall only be accessible to authorized individuals.
- Information shall remain accurate, complete, and protected from unauthorized modification.
- Information and systems shall remain available to authorized users when required.
Personal data shall be collected, processed, stored, and shared only for legitimate business purposes and in accordance with applicable laws.
Users shall be accountable for activities performed using their credentials.

sections.title: Access Control Policy
paragraphs: Access to systems and information shall be granted based on:
- Users shall receive only the minimum access necessary.
- Access shall be restricted to authorized personnel with legitimate business requirements.
- Access shall be assigned according to job responsibilities.
- User access shall be reviewed periodically.

sections.title: Data Protection
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall implement controls to protect customer and business information.
- Customer information shall be stored in secure environments with appropriate access controls.
- Sensitive information shall be masked where feasible.
- Only information necessary for legitimate business purposes shall be collected and retained.

sections.title: Application Security
paragraphs: All applications shall be developed and maintained using secure development practices.
- Security Testing Prior to Production Deployment
- OWASP Top 10 security risks shall be considered during development.

sections.title: Cloud Security
paragraphs: Cloud environments shall be configured securely and monitored regularly.
- Cloud providers shall undergo appropriate due diligence prior to engagement.

sections.title: Vulnerability Management
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall maintain a vulnerability management program.
- Critical vulnerabilities shall be prioritized for immediate remediation.

sections.title: Security Monitoring and Logging
paragraphs: Security events shall be monitored and logged.
- Logs shall be retained and protected from unauthorized modification.

sections.title: Incident Response Management
paragraphs: MoneyCash shall maintain an Incident Response Plan to address cybersecurity incidents.
- Material incidents shall be reported to stakeholders and regulators where required.

sections.title: Regulatory Disclosure
paragraphs: MoneyCash operates as a Lending Service Provider (LSP) and processes customer information on behalf of regulated lending institutions including Aasra Fincorp Pvt. Ltd.

MoneyCash is committed to implementing appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard customer information and maintain compliance with applicable cybersecurity, privacy, and digital lending regulations.
